description: Search federal awards by keyword, recipient, agency, award type, NAICS code, assistance listing (CFDA) number, PSC, DEF code, extent competed, set-aside, contract pricing, location, or date range. Location filters by place of performance (location_filter, or filters.place_of_performance_location, which overrides it) or by where the recipient is based (filters.recipient_location). The contract filters extent_competed_type_codes, set_aside_type_codes, and contract_pricing_type_codes take the FPDS codes usaspending_get_award returns: 1–8 letters or digits, sent uppercased; an empty list is unset, several values match any of them, and an unknown code matches nothing. Only contracts and IDVs carry these codes, so a call whose award types include an assistance code is rejected as contract_filters_type_mismatch. Returns ranked award summaries including recipient names, amounts, awarding agencies, and generated award IDs for use with usaspending_get_award; loan rows carry loan value, subsidy cost, and issue date in place of award amount and dates. Rows carry the recipient_id that opens usaspending_get_recipient, and the recipient UEI, when upstream has them; page_metadata.total counts every match for the call's filters and award_type_codes. Page numbers reach results up to a 50,000-result offset (page × limit); past it, continue with last_record_sort_value and last_record_unique_id from page_metadata, which the upstream returns only while page × limit is under 10,000, so capture the pair before then. With both cursor fields supplied, page is ignored. Award types: A/B/C/D = contracts, IDV_A–IDV_E = IDVs, 02/03/04/05/F001/F002 = grants, 06/10/F006/F007 = direct payments, 07/08/F003/F004 = loans, 09/11/-1/F005/F008/F009/F010 = other assistance. Dates must be ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD). Earliest data: 2007-10-01 via search API. DoD contracts have a 90-day publication lag.

agency_name.description: Awarding top-tier or sub-tier agency name. Use the matched name from usaspending_autocomplete_filters type=awarding_agency, or toptier_name to select the whole parent department. A sub-tier name shared by several parents matches under all parents. Exact case-insensitive names and unambiguous abbreviations resolve to the directory spelling.

assistance_listings.description: Filter by Assistance Listing (CFDA) program numbers, e.g. ["15.507"]: two digits, a dot, then three digits or capital letters (11.67A). Matches an award when any of its listings equals one of these exactly; several values match any of them. A matching award's primary listing can differ from the one requested, and amounts cover the whole award, not that listing's share. Only assistance awards (grants, direct payments, loans, other assistance) carry listings, so a call whose award types are all contracts or IDVs — including a contract default — is rejected as assistance_listings_type_mismatch. Use usaspending_autocomplete_filters type=cfda to look up numbers.

award_type_codes.description: Filter by award type codes. All codes must belong to a single group: A/B/C/D (contracts), IDV_A/IDV_B/IDV_B_A/IDV_B_B/IDV_B_C/IDV_C/IDV_D/IDV_E (IDVs), 02/03/04/05/F001/F002 (grants), 06/10/F006/F007 (direct payments), 07/08/F003/F004 (loans), 09/11/-1/F005/F008/F009/F010 (other assistance). Defaults to contracts. Mixing groups causes a 422 error. The group decides which sort values apply.

contract_pricing_type_codes.description: Filter by contract pricing type, the contract_pricing.code usaspending_get_award returns: J firm fixed price, K fixed price with economic price adjustment, L fixed price incentive, M fixed price award fee, A fixed price redetermination, B fixed price level of effort, R cost plus award fee, S cost no fee, T cost sharing, U cost plus fixed fee, V cost plus incentive fee, Y time and materials, Z labor hours, 1 order dependent, 2 combination, 3 other.

items.description: FPDS contract pricing code, e.g. J

def_codes.description: Filter by Disaster Emergency Fund Codes (DEF), e.g. ["Z"], or ["L", "M", "N", "O", "P"] for COVID-19: 1–3 letters or digits, sent uppercased. Discover codes with usaspending_autocomplete_filters type=def_code. Matches awards of any type funded under any of these codes. Amounts cover the whole matching award, not the share funded by the code, and DEF-filtered totals can be negative. An unknown code is rejected with the list of codes USAspending accepts.

items.description: Disaster Emergency Fund Code, e.g. Z or L

extent_competed_type_codes.description: Filter by extent competed, the competition.extent_competed.code usaspending_get_award returns: A full and open competition, B not available for competition, C not competed, D full and open after exclusion of sources, E follow-on to competed action, F competed under simplified acquisition procedures (SAP), G not competed under SAP, CDO competitive delivery order, NDO non-competitive delivery order.

filters.description: Optional analytics-style filter object mirroring the shape the spending analytics tools accept, for reusing one filter set across tools. A nonempty value here wins over its top-level counterpart per field; an empty list, a blank string, or an all-blank location falls back to the top-level value. recipient_id is rejected — this endpoint silently ignores it; filter by recipient via recipient_name. The three contract filters are award search's alone; the analytics tools reject them.

items.description: FPDS contract pricing code, e.g. J
Disaster Emergency Fund Code, e.g. Z or L

keywords.description: Same as the top-level keyword, as a list of terms.

items.description: Product and Service Code or prefix, e.g. Y1NE or Y1

recipient_location.description: Same as the top-level location_filter, but filters by where the recipient is based, which can differ from where the work is done; the location sent is echoed as applied_recipient_location.

anyOf.description: Date as YYYY-MM-DD; month and day may be unpadded
Date as YYYY-MM-DD; month and day may be unpadded

funding_agency_name.description: Funding top-tier or sub-tier agency name. Use the matched name from usaspending_autocomplete_filters type=funding_agency. Exact case-insensitive names and unambiguous abbreviations resolve to the directory spelling. When agency_name is also supplied, awards must match both roles.

keyword.description: Full-text search across award descriptions, recipient names, and place names; effective keywords need at least three characters without trimming; empty is unset

last_record_sort_value.description: Keyset-pagination cursor: the last_record_sort_value from a prior response page_metadata. Provide together with last_record_unique_id.

last_record_unique_id.description: Keyset-pagination cursor: the last_record_unique_id from a prior response page_metadata. Provide together with last_record_sort_value.

limit.description: Awards per page. Default 10, at most 100 per call.

location_filter.description: Filter by place of performance. Takes codes, not place names — resolve a state or county name to its code with usaspending_autocomplete_filters type=location. Blank fields are ignored, and an all-blank object is no location filter. The location sent is echoed as applied_location.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code (e.g., USA); USA when omitted. A US territory code — PRI, GUM, VIR, ASM, MNP — is sent as USA with the territory as state.

county.description: US county FIPS code: 3 digits with state (049 with state NM), or the 5-digit state + county code (35049, Santa Fe County, NM), whose first two digits set the state — the form usaspending_spending_by_geography county rows carry as shape_code.

state.description: Under USA (the default): a US state, DC, territory, freely associated state, or armed-forces code as a 2-letter postal code (NM, PR, FM, AE) or 2-digit FIPS code (35). Under another country: that country's own 2-letter subdivision code (ON with CAN).

naics_codes.description: NAICS codes: canonical 2, 4, or 6 digits; recognized ASCII integer aliases normalize whitespace, plus, leading zeros and digit underscores; unclassified spellings remain provider-validated. Use usaspending_autocomplete_filters type=naics to look up codes.

psc_codes.description: Filter by Product and Service Codes (PSC), e.g. ["Y1NE"]: 1–4 letters or digits, sent uppercased. A shorter code covers every code under it ("Y1" covers "Y1NE"); several values match any of them. Only contracts and IDVs carry a PSC, so a call whose award types are all assistance types is rejected as psc_codes_type_mismatch, and pairing psc_codes with assistance_listings matches nothing, since no award carries both. Use usaspending_autocomplete_filters type=psc to look up codes.

items.description: Product and Service Code or prefix, e.g. Y1NE or Y1

recipient_name.description: Filter by recipient name (partial match); maps to this endpoint's recipient_search_text. This endpoint has no recipient_id filter — use usaspending_search_recipients to look up a recipient by name.

set_aside_type_codes.description: Filter by set-aside type, the competition.type_set_aside.code usaspending_get_award returns: NONE no set-aside used, SBA small business total, SBP small business partial, 8A 8(a) competed, 8AN 8(a) sole source, 8AC SDB 8(a) set-aside, HZC HUBZone, HZS HUBZone sole source, HS2 HUBZone and 8(a), HS3 8(a) with HUBZone preference, SDVOSBC service-disabled veteran-owned small business (SDVOSB), SDVOSBS SDVOSB sole source, VSA veteran, VSS veteran sole source, WOSB women-owned small business, WOSBSS WOSB sole source, EDWOSB economically disadvantaged WOSB, EDWOSBSS EDWOSB sole source, HMT HBCU or minority institution total, HMP HBCU or minority institution partial, ESB emerging small business, RSB reserved for small business, VSB very small business, BI Buy Indian, IEE Indian economic enterprise, ISBEE Indian small business economic enterprise. Most recent contracts carry no set-aside code at all, not even NONE, so no value matches them; most IDVs (IDV_A–IDV_E) carry one.

sort.description: Sort field for results. Loans (07/08/F003/F004) sort by Loan Value, Subsidy Cost, Issued Date, Recipient Name, or Awarding Agency, defaulting to Loan Value. Every other group sorts by Award Amount, Total Outlays, Start Date, End Date, Recipient Name, or Awarding Agency, defaulting to Award Amount — except IDVs, which have no End Date. A sort the group does not support is rejected before the search runs.

time_period.description: Filter awards by date range (action date). Omit both bounds or leave both blank to query USAspending's available coverage without a date filter. One blank end is filled and named in the notice.

anyOf.description: Date as YYYY-MM-DD; month and day may be unpadded

end_date.description: End date in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD). Blank ("") leaves the end open, filled with today (UTC).

anyOf.description: Date as YYYY-MM-DD; month and day may be unpadded

start_date.description: Start date in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD); earliest valid: 2007-10-01. Blank ("") leaves the start open, filled with 2007-10-01.

name: usaspending_search_awards

applied_agency_name.description: Awarding agency name sent to USAspending

applied_funding_agency_name.description: Funding agency name sent to USAspending

applied_keyword.description: Keyword filter applied to this search

applied_location.description: Place of performance location sent, as normalized (e.g. country=USA, state=NM, county=049)

applied_recipient_location.description: Recipient location sent, as normalized (e.g. country=USA, state=WA)

applied_time_period_end.description: End of the date range sent (YYYY-MM-DD), including a filled-in end

applied_time_period_start.description: Start of the date range sent (YYYY-MM-DD), including a filled-in start

cap.description: Per-page cap (limit) applied to this page, when truncated.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_keyword`: An effective keyword has fewer than three characters. `invalid_naics_code`: An effective NAICS code is known to be invalid. `incomplete_cursor`: Only one of last_record_sort_value and last_record_unique_id was supplied. `api_unavailable`: USAspending.gov API is unreachable or returns an error. `api_timeout`: USAspending.gov did not respond before the request deadline elapsed. `pagination_limit_exceeded`: page multiplied by limit exceeds the endpoint 50,000-result page window and no cursor was supplied. `date_before_earliest`: The resolved start date precedes the 2007-10-01 earliest date this endpoint can search. `date_range_inverted`: Both ends of the date range were supplied and the start date falls after the end date. `unsupported_sort`: The sort value is not one the award type group supports. `assistance_listings_type_mismatch`: assistance_listings was given while the award type codes include contract or IDV codes, or were left at the contract default. `psc_codes_type_mismatch`: psc_codes was given while the award type codes include assistance codes. `contract_filters_type_mismatch`: extent_competed_type_codes, set_aside_type_codes, or contract_pricing_type_codes was given while the award type codes include assistance codes. `invalid_location`: location_filter, filters.place_of_performance_location, or filters.recipient_location names an unknown US state, a county without a state or under an armed-forces code, a county or FIPS-number state under a non-USA country, or parts that place it in different states. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

limitClamp.description: Present when a count input above its per-call cap was reduced to the cap.

applied.description: Value the call used: the per-call cap

matches_by_group.description: Awards matching every filter but award_type_codes, per award-type group — what a search of another group would find. The selected group's entry counts the whole group, so it can exceed page_metadata.total when award_type_codes name part of it. A filter only some groups carry (naics_codes, psc_codes, the contract filters, assistance_listings) leaves the others at 0. Absent when award_type_codes is the only filter. Best-effort: absent when its count failed or ran more than 2 s past the search and the total count, which unavailable_sections then names.

notice.description: A reduced limit, how to page on, the use of available coverage without a date filter or any filled date bound, active filters on an empty page, other award-type groups with matches and their award_type_codes, and any section that failed to load. Absent when none applies.

page_metadata.description: Pagination metadata: has_next, the page and limit, the total match count, and the keyset cursor pair. With total known on page-number paging, has_next is true exactly when rows lie past this page. Without it — the count failed, or the page came by cursor — has_next is true on any full page, because the upstream's own next-page flag reads false on every page past a 10,000-result offset; an exactly-full final page then reports one page more than exists, and a short or empty page marks the end. The cursor pair is absent once page × limit reaches 10,000, where the upstream stops emitting it.

last_record_sort_value.description: Keyset-pagination cursor for the next page — pass back as last_record_sort_value.

last_record_unique_id.description: Keyset-pagination cursor for the next page — pass back as last_record_unique_id alongside last_record_sort_value.

total.description: Awards matching every filter, award_type_codes included, across all pages: codes naming part of a group count only that part, so matches_by_group's entry for the group can exceed it. Absent when the total count failed; unavailable_sections then names it.

items.description: Award summary with amounts, agencies, and chaining IDs

agency_slug.description: URL-friendly awarding-agency slug (e.g., national-aeronautics-and-space-administration) — pass to usaspending_get_agency as agency_slug. Absent when the agency has no profile page.

award_id.description: Display award ID (piid, fain, or uri) — NOT the chaining ID

generated_internal_id.description: Generated unique award ID — pass to usaspending_get_award to fetch full details

issued_date.description: Date the loan was issued (YYYY-MM-DD; loans only — they carry no start or end date)

loan_value.description: Face value of the loan in USD (loans only — they carry no award_amount)

recipient_id.description: Recipient hash ID with its level suffix (-C, -R, or -P) — pass to usaspending_get_recipient for the profile. Absent when upstream has none, as on rows aggregated as MULTIPLE RECIPIENTS.

subsidy_cost.description: Original subsidy cost of the loan in USD — the estimated long-term cost to the government (loans only)

uei.description: Recipient Unique Entity Identifier. Absent when upstream has none.

shown.description: Number of awards returned on this page, when truncated.

truncated.description: True when rows are known to lie past this page: page × limit is below the total, or the upstream reports a next page. Unlike has_next, a full page alone never sets it.

unavailable_sections.description: Present when a count request failed, was rejected, or ran past the 10-second deadline both counts share, or when the group count ran more than 2 s past the search and the total count; the awards on the page are unaffected. Absent when every count sent loaded.

items.description: A section omitted from the result because its request failed

message.description: The failure message for this section.

reason.description: api_unavailable: USAspending was unreachable, throttled the request, or answered with a server error. api_timeout: no answer before the request deadline. upstream_error: USAspending rejected the request, or its record lacks the identifier the section is requested by.

retryable.description: Whether retrying the call may load this section.

section.description: total: page_metadata.total and totalCount, from the count sent with the search's filters. matches_by_group: matches_by_group, from the count sent without award_type_codes.

upstream_messages.description: Notices the USAspending API returned with this response — e.g. a supplied filter it ignored because this endpoint does not support it. Every successful response also carries a standing advisory that search covers 2007-10-01 onward; that advisory is boilerplate, not a verdict on the dates requested. Present whenever the API returns any messages.

title: Search Federal Awards
